huddable.hub.designer.tooltip: Move, scale, hide and restyle HUD elements, pick their fonts, and manage layout profiles
huddable.hub.general.tooltip: Settings for the whole game, not one profile, such as font quality
huddable.general.title: Huddable: General Settings
huddable.general.meowdding_overlays.desc: List each overlay from meowdding-lib mods (SkyCubed, SkyOcean) as its own element, so you can move, scale and hide it. Turn off if they misbehave or you'd rather place them with their own editor.
huddable.general.font_quality.desc: How sharp TrueType fonts from resource packs are drawn (their oversample). Higher is sharper at large GUI scales but uses more video memory; Pack's own uses each pack's setting. Applies to every mod's fonts, not just Huddable's, and reloads the resource packs when you leave.
huddable.editor.elements.tooltip: Show or hide HUD elements from a list
huddable.editor.font.tooltip: Profile font: %s. Every element that draws text uses it unless it has a font of its own (right-click it). Fonts come from your resource packs
huddable.editor.size.tooltip: How the whole HUD's size follows the screen. GUI: Minecraft's GUI Scale. Window: grows and shrinks with the window. Fixed: the same size at any GUI Scale
huddable.editor.export.tooltip: Copy this layout to the clipboard as a code
huddable.editor.import.tooltip: Load a layout code from the clipboard as a new profile
huddable.editor.reset.tooltip: Put every element back to vanilla
huddable.editor.hint.live: Drag to move (Shift: no snap), corner to scale, edge to resize, right-click for options, Elements to show/hide
huddable.editor.hint.preview: Join a world for a live preview. Drag to move, corner to scale, edge to resize, right-click for options
huddable.editor.list.title: HUD elements
huddable.editor.font.profile.tooltip: Use the profile font (toolbar Font button)
huddable.editor.font.vanilla.element_too: Minecraft's own font, even when the profile has another
huddable.editor.font.pack_off:
%s
Its resource pack is off, so this draws in vanilla's font
huddable.editor.status.exported: Layout code copied to the clipboard
huddable.editor.status.no_code: The clipboard has no Huddable code (HUD1:...)
